name: 4.3 通過時間撈取過站不良信息
sql:
WITH filtered_wip AS (
    SELECT 
        a.SN,
        a.LOTNO,
        a.CHECKOUTTIME,
        a.OPNO
    FROM t_wiplotsnlog a
    WHERE 
  a.CHECKOUTTIME >= TO_DATE('{0}', 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS')
      AND 
  a.CHECKOUTTIME < TO_DATE('{1}', 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS')
      AND 
  a.OPNO IN ('0642', '0643')
      AND 
  a.LOTNO LIKE '%-__'
),
project_phase_data AS (
    SELECT 
        a.SN,
        a.LOTNO,
        a.ATT1,
        a.PROJECTPHASE,
        b.ITEMNAME,
        b.SUBITEMNAME,
        c.VCMID,
  c.TESTIP AS AAMCIP,
        c.ATT2 AS AAHEAD,
  d.PROGRAMNAME,
  d.ATT3 AS CUT,
  e.ATT3 AS CUD,
  f.ATT3 AS CAPS,
  g.RIVERSION AS Combine
    FROM testsncurrentbak a
    LEFT JOIN testdefectcodesetting b ON a.ATT1 = b.ATT1 AND b.ITEMNAME IN (
        'APS_OOV_Trim_Pre',
        'APS_Gain_Trim',
        'APS_OOV_Trim_Post',
        'VCM_bidirectional_Test',
        'SFR20_PeakSearch',
        'SFR40_PeakSearch',
        'TescCheck_UP',
        'BescCheck_UP',
        'TescCheck_Down',
        'BescCheck_Down',
        'APS_Calibration',
        'APS_Resonance',
        'VCM_Resonance',
        'APS_FocusMargin',
        'APS_OpticalOffset',
        'APS_TescCheck',
        'APS_CLT_AFDST_TESC'
    )
    LEFT JOIN testfolaaimagebak c ON a.SN = c.SN
  LEFT JOIN ldunld14bak d ON a.SN = d.SN
  LEFT JOIN imagetest24bak e ON a.SN = e.SN
  LEFT JOIN APS3bak f ON a.SN = f.SN
  LEFT JOIN t_lotconfigdata g ON a.LOTNO = g.LOTNO
  WHERE b.ITEMNAME IS NOT NULL
),
time_functions AS (
    SELECT 
        t.SN,
        CASE 
            WHEN TO_CHAR(t.CHECKOUTTIME, 'HH24:MI') >= '06:00' 
            THEN TO_CHAR(t.CHECKOUTTIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
            ELSE TO_CHAR(t.CHECKOUTTIME - INTERVAL '1' DAY, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
        END AS UpDate_TIME
    FROM filtered_wip t
)

SELECT
    'WK' || TO_CHAR(
        (TRUNC(TO_DATE(q.UpDate_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'D') - TRUNC(TO_DATE('2026-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'D')) / 7 + 1, 
        'FM999'
    ) AS WEEK,
    q.UpDate_TIME,
  CASE 
  WHEN UPPER(SUBSTR(p.PROGRAMNAME, -1, 1)) = 'W' THEN 'CHS-W'
  WHEN UPPER(SUBSTR(p.PROGRAMNAME, -1, 1)) = 'K' THEN 'CHS-K'
  WHEN UPPER(SUBSTR(p.PROGRAMNAME, -1, 1)) = 'S' THEN 'CHS-S'
  WHEN UPPER(SUBSTR(p.PROGRAMNAME, -1, 1)) = 'T' THEN 'CHS-T'
  WHEN UPPER(SUBSTR(p.PROGRAMNAME, -1, 1)) = 'E' THEN 'CHS-E'
  WHEN UPPER(SUBSTR(p.PROGRAMNAME, -1, 1)) = 'V' THEN 'CHS-V'
  ELSE 'UNKNOWN'
  END AS PROJECT,
  p.PROJECTPHASE AS CONFIG,
  CASE 
        WHEN SUBSTR(p.VCMID, 1, 1) = 'A' THEN 'Alps'
        WHEN SUBSTR(p.VCMID, 1, 1) = 'L' THEN 'ICT'
        ELSE 'UNKNOWN'
    END AS VENDOR,
    SUBSTR(p.Combine, 1, INSTR(p.Combine || '+', '+') - 1) AS Combine,
    NULL AS VA,
    CASE 
  WHEN SUBSTR(p.CAPS, 2, 3) = '678' THEN 'CAPS'
  WHEN SUBSTR(p.CUD, 2, 3) = '677' THEN 'CUD'
  WHEN SUBSTR(p.CUT, 2, 3) = '676' THEN 'CUT'
    ELSE NULL
    END AS Station,
    w.LOTNO,
  NULL AS SN,
    p.SN AS SensorID,
    p.VCMID,
  NULL AS OISID,
  NULL AS VAID,
    p.ITEMNAME,
    p.SUBITEMNAME,
  NULL AS Category1,
  NULL AS Category2,
  NULL AS FAResult,
  CASE 
        WHEN SUBSTR(p.VCMID, 1, 1) = 'A' THEN TO_CHAR(SUBSTR(p.VCMID, 8, 2))
        WHEN SUBSTR(p.VCMID, 1, 1) = 'L' THEN TO_CHAR(SUBSTR(p.VCMID, 8, 1))
        ELSE 'UNKNOWN'
    END AS Line,
    SUBSTR(p.VCMID, 13, 2) AS Tooling,
    p.AAMCIP,
    p.AAHEAD
FROM filtered_wip w
INNER JOIN project_phase_data p ON w.SN = p.VCMID
INNER JOIN time_functions q ON w.SN = q.SN
ORDER BY w.CHECKOUTTIME

name: 34.1 通过时间捞取MFG过站不良(CHS)
sql:
WITH filtered_wip AS (
    SELECT 
        a.SN,
        a.LOTNO,
        a.CHECKOUTTIME,
        a.OPNO
    FROM t_wiplotsnlog a
    WHERE 
  a.CHECKOUTTIME >= TO_DATE('{0}', 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS')
      AND 
  a.CHECKOUTTIME < TO_DATE('{1}', 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS')
      AND 
  a.OPNO IN ('0642', '0643', '0640')
      AND 
  a.LOTNO LIKE '%-__'
),
project_phase_data AS (
    SELECT 
        a.SN,
        a.LOTNO,
        a.ATT1,
        a.PROJECTPHASE,
        b.ITEMNAME,
        b.SUBITEMNAME,
        c.VCMID,
        c.TESTIP AS AAMCIP,
        c.ATT2 AS AAHEAD,
  d.PROGRAMNAME,
  d.ATT3 AS CUT,
  e.ATT3 AS CUD,
  f.ATT3 AS CAPS,
  g.RIVERSION AS Combine
    FROM testsncurrentbak a
    LEFT JOIN testdefectcodesetting b ON a.ATT1 = b.ATT1 AND b.ITEMNAME IN (
        'APS_OOV_Trim_Pre',
        'APS_Gain_Trim',
        'APS_OOV_Trim_Post',
        'VCM_bidirectional_Test',
        'SFR20_PeakSearch',
        'SFR40_PeakSearch',
        'TescCheck_UP',
        'BescCheck_UP',
        'TescCheck_Down',
        'BescCheck_Down',
        'APS_Calibration',
        'APS_Resonance',
        'VCM_Resonance',
        'APS_FocusMargin',
        'APS_OpticalOffset',
        'APS_TescCheck',
        'APS_CLT_AFDST_TESC'
    )
    LEFT JOIN testfolaaimagebak c ON a.SN = c.SN
  LEFT JOIN ldunld14bak d ON a.SN = d.SN
  LEFT JOIN imagetest24bak e ON a.SN = e.SN
  LEFT JOIN APS3bak f ON a.SN = f.SN
  LEFT JOIN t_lotconfigdata g ON a.LOTNO = g.LOTNO
  WHERE b.ITEMNAME IS NOT NULL
),
time_functions AS (
    SELECT 
        t.SN,
        CASE 
            WHEN TO_CHAR(t.CHECKOUTTIME, 'HH24:MI') >= '06:00' 
            THEN TO_CHAR(t.CHECKOUTTIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
            ELSE TO_CHAR(t.CHECKOUTTIME - INTERVAL '1' DAY, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
        END AS UpDate_TIME
    FROM filtered_wip t
)

SELECT
    'WK' || TO_CHAR(
        (TRUNC(TO_DATE(q.UpDate_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'D') - TRUNC(TO_DATE('2026-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'D')) / 7 + 1, 
        'FM999'
    ) AS WEEK,
    q.UpDate_TIME,
  CASE 
  WHEN UPPER(SUBSTR(p.PROGRAMNAME, -1, 1)) = 'W' THEN 'CHS-W'
  WHEN UPPER(SUBSTR(p.PROGRAMNAME, -1, 1)) = 'K' THEN 'CHS-K'
  WHEN UPPER(SUBSTR(p.PROGRAMNAME, -1, 1)) = 'S' THEN 'CHS-S'
  WHEN UPPER(SUBSTR(p.PROGRAMNAME, -1, 1)) = 'Z' THEN 'CHS-Z'
  WHEN UPPER(SUBSTR(p.PROGRAMNAME, -1, 1)) = 'T' THEN 'CHS-T'
  WHEN UPPER(SUBSTR(p.PROGRAMNAME, -1, 1)) = 'E' THEN 'CHS-E'
  WHEN UPPER(SUBSTR(p.PROGRAMNAME, -1, 1)) = 'V' THEN 'CHS-V'
  WHEN UPPER(SUBSTR(p.PROGRAMNAME, -1, 1)) = 'Y' THEN 'CHS-Y'
  ELSE 'UNKNOWN'
  END AS PROJECT,
  p.PROJECTPHASE AS CONFIG,
  CASE 
        WHEN SUBSTR(p.VCMID, 1, 1) = 'A' THEN 'Alps'
        WHEN SUBSTR(p.VCMID, 1, 1) = 'L' THEN 'ICT'
        ELSE 'UNKNOWN'
    END AS VENDOR,
    SUBSTR(p.Combine, 1, INSTR(p.Combine || '+', '+') - 1) AS Combine,
    NULL AS VA,
    CASE 
  WHEN SUBSTR(p.CAPS, 2, 3) = '678' THEN 'CAPS'
  WHEN SUBSTR(p.CUD, 2, 3) = '677' THEN 'CUD'
  WHEN SUBSTR(p.CUT, 2, 3) = '676' THEN 'CUT'
    ELSE NULL
    END AS Station,
    w.LOTNO,
  NULL AS SN,
    p.SN AS SensorID,
    p.VCMID,
  NULL AS OISID,
  NULL AS VAID,
    p.ITEMNAME,
    p.SUBITEMNAME,
  NULL AS Category1,
  NULL AS Category2,
  NULL AS FAResult,
  CASE 
        WHEN SUBSTR(p.VCMID, 1, 1) = 'A' THEN TO_CHAR(SUBSTR(p.VCMID, 8, 2))
        WHEN SUBSTR(p.VCMID, 1, 1) = 'L' THEN TO_CHAR(SUBSTR(p.VCMID, 8, 1))
        ELSE 'UNKNOWN'
    END AS Line,
    SUBSTR(p.VCMID, 13, 2) AS Tooling,
    p.AAMCIP,
    p.AAHEAD
FROM filtered_wip w
INNER JOIN project_phase_data p ON w.SN = p.VCMID
INNER JOIN time_functions q ON w.SN = q.SN
ORDER BY w.CHECKOUTTIME

WHEN a.att4 IS NULL OR a.att5 IS NULL OR a.att4 = '' OR a.att5 = '' THEN ''
